title: Debugging toolkit: LLDB, breakpoints, Instruments, sanitizers
summary: Know your tools: breakpoints and LLDB to inspect state, the View and Memory Graph debuggers for UI and leaks, Instruments to measure performance, and sanitizers to catch memory and threading bugs.
body: **Breakpoints:** conditional breakpoints (stop only when `id == 42`), breakpoints that log and continue (no code changes), **exception breakpoint** (stop where an ObjC exception is thrown), **Swift error breakpoint**, symbolic breakpoints (e.g. `UIViewAlertForUnsatisfiableConstraints` for Auto Layout problems).
**LLDB commands:** `po obj` (print description), `p` / `v` (print values; `v` is fast and does not run code), `expr` (run code, change values), `bt` (backtrace), `thread list`, `frame variable`.
**Visual debuggers:** View Debugger (3D view hierarchy, constraints, clipped views), Memory Graph Debugger (who holds an object, cycles marked with purple "!").
**Instruments:** Time Profiler (where CPU time goes), Allocations and Leaks (memory), Hangs and Animation Hitches, SwiftUI (body updates), Network, Energy Log, App Launch.

**Diagnostics in the scheme:** Address Sanitizer (memory corruption, use-after-free), Thread Sanitizer (data races), Undefined Behavior Sanitizer, Main Thread Checker (UI off main), Zombie Objects (messages to freed objects).
**Logging:** `Logger` (OSLog) with subsystems and categories, privacy markers (`\(email, privacy: .private)`), viewable in Console.app and Instruments.
**Process:** reproduce → isolate (binary search with git bisect or feature flags) → find root cause → fix → add a test.
keyPoints: Conditional, logging, exception and symbolic breakpoints save time.
Memory Graph for leaks; View Debugger for layout.
Instruments: Time Profiler, Allocations, Leaks, Hangs, SwiftUI.
Sanitizers: ASan, TSan, Main Thread Checker, Zombies.

code.caption: Structured logging with privacy

mistakes: Using `print` everywhere and leaving it in release builds.
Profiling debug builds (optimizations off, numbers misleading).
followups: **How do you debug a bug you cannot reproduce?** Add targeted logging/metrics, check crash and hang reports, compare device/OS/app version, use feature flags to narrow down.
**What is a zombie object?** A deallocated object still being messaged; enabling Zombies turns the crash into a clear message.
